A clean, lubed chain costs seconds a week and buys months of drivetrain
life. Wipe the chain dry after wet rides — water washes the grease out
and grit grinds it in.

Lube sparingly on the inside of the links, let it soak, then wipe the
excess off; a chain that looks greasy collects more dirt than a dry
one. Check stretch with the cheap gauge on the first of each month and
replace before the cassette starts wearing with it.
